source.description.zh-Hans: 繁中漫画站，日漫、欧美漫画和画集都能找到。网站设有单独的高清单行本区，也有机战、竞技、美食等细分题材。
source.description.zh-Hant: 繁中漫畫站，日漫、歐美漫畫與畫集都能找到。站上另有高清單行本區，題材細分至機戰、競技與美食。
source.description.en: A Traditional Chinese library of Japanese manga, Western comics and art books. The site has a dedicated collected-volumes section and categories for mecha, sports and food.
